rules.title: Limit girder and header spans to Tables R602.7(1)-(3)
rules.intent: Ensure dimension-lumber girders and headers carrying floor loads are sized within prescriptive span limits so they do not deflect or fail under the assumed gravity loads.
evidence_required: Framing plan showing each girder and header with member size, species/grade, and clear span
Span calculations or call-outs referencing Table R602.7(1), R602.7(2), or R602.7(3)
Loading assumptions (number of stories supported, snow load, building width) matching the table column used
Lumber grade stamp or specification confirming species and grade assumed in the table

rules.title: Nail floor framing per Table R602.3(1) and provide positive uplift/lateral connections at posts and beams
rules.intent: Ensure floor framing develops the lateral and uplift load path by using the prescribed fastening schedule and positive connections at post-and-beam supports.
evidence_required: Framing details and nailing schedule on plans matching Table R602.3(1) line items for floor framing
Connection details (clips, straps, or hangers) at every post-to-beam and beam-to-girder interface that supports floor framing
Specification of nail type, size, and spacing for joist-to-plate, joist-to-rim, blocking, and lap-splice locations
Manufacturer cut sheets or ICC-ES reports for any proprietary connectors used in lieu of nailed connections

rules.title: Design and fasten exterior wood-frame walls per Figures R602.3(1)-(2) and Tables R602.3(1)-(4); studs continuous from sole to top plate
rules.intent: Establish the prescriptive baseline for wood-frame exterior wall design, fastening, sheathing wind resistance, and continuity of studs so the wall develops both gravity and out-of-plane load paths.
evidence_required: Wall framing elevations showing studs running continuous from sole plate to top plate at each support
Fastening schedule on plans matching Tables R602.3(1) through R602.3(4) for sheathing, plates, and studs
Wind-pressure verification for exterior sheathing from Table R301.2.1(1) with height/exposure adjustment from Table R301.2.1(2), keyed to Table R602.3(3) sheathing requirements
If designed by AWC NDS instead of prescriptive figures, signed/sealed structural calculations on file

rules.title: Connect braced wall panels to floor framing or foundation with rim/blocking and Table R602.3(1) fastening
rules.intent: Provide a continuous shear-and-uplift load path from each braced wall panel into the floor diaphragm or foundation by requiring rim joists, end joists, or blocking and prescribed nailing.
evidence_required: Braced wall panel connection details showing rim joist, band joist, end joist, or blocking along the full panel length above and below
Plate-to-framing nailing call-outs taken from Table R602.3(1)
Where joists are parallel and a parallel member cannot be located above/below the panel, details of full-depth blocking at 16 inches o.c. on each side
For panels bearing on concrete or masonry, anchor bolt schedule and detail per Section R403.1.6

rules.title: Construct cold-formed steel exterior and interior load-bearing walls per Section R603 (scope)
rules.intent: Direct designers using cold-formed steel wall framing to the prescriptive subsections that govern wall-to-foundation connections, stud sizing, and bracing so the assembly is built within the AISI S230-based applicability limits.
evidence_required: Identification on plans that walls are CFS framed and which walls are load-bearing exterior vs. interior load-bearing
Confirmation that the building falls within R603.1.1 applicability limits (≤60 ft long, ≤40 ft wide, ≤3 stories, wind <140 mph, Exposure B or C, snow ≤70 psf)
Cross-references on the structural sheets to R603.3.1 (anchorage), R603.3.2 (stud size), and R603.9 (bracing)

rules.title: Anchor cold-formed steel walls to foundation/floor per Table R603.3.1 with anchor-bolt placement and embedment
rules.intent: Provide a prescriptive shear-and-uplift connection between CFS walls and the supporting foundation or floor using tabulated screws, anchor bolts, and minimum embedment so the wall transfers lateral and overturning loads.
evidence_required: Foundation/floor anchorage detail showing screws or anchor bolts sized and spaced per Table R603.3.1 for the design wind speed and exposure category
Plan callouts confirming anchor bolts are within 12 inches of corners and ends of bottom tracks
Embedment dimensions on the foundation detail showing ≥15 in into masonry or ≥7 in into concrete
Manufacturer cut sheets and ICC-ES report when foundation anchor straps are substituted for anchor bolts

rules.title: Size cold-formed steel wall studs per Tables R603.3.2(2)-(16); fasten per Table R603.3.2(1); top/bottom tracks match stud thickness
rules.intent: Ensure CFS exterior and interior load-bearing wall studs are sized for the controlling wind, snow, height, and spacing combination and that tracks and fasteners match so axial and lateral capacity assumed in the tables is realized.
evidence_required: CFS stud schedule showing member size, thickness (mils), and steel grade for each wall, keyed to the applicable Table R603.3.2(2) through R603.3.2(16)
Design parameters on the structural cover sheet (ultimate wind speed, exposure category, stud spacing, building width, ground snow load, attic load, story count) matching the table column
Track schedule confirming top and bottom tracks are at least the same thickness as the studs
Where a thinner stud is used by exception, gypsum board and structural sheathing specs and fastening schedules per R603.2.5/R702/R603.9.1 and Table R603.3.2(1)
Connection schedule showing screw type, size, and spacing per Section R603.2.5 and Table R603.3.2(1)

rules.title: Identify, span, and fasten wood structural panel wall sheathing per R604.1-R604.3
rules.intent: Ensure wood structural panel wall sheathing is a recognized graded panel, used within its allowable span, and fastened per the prescriptive nailing schedules so it can deliver the assumed shear and out-of-plane capacity.
evidence_required: Panel specification on plans referencing DOC PS 1, DOC PS 2, ANSI/APA PRP 210, CSA O325, or CSA O437
Photograph or call-out for the APA/agency grade mark on each panel type used
Sheathing schedule showing stud spacing and panel span rating within the limits of Table R602.3(3)
Nailing schedule for wall sheathing matching Table R602.3(1) or R602.3(3) (nail type, size, edge and field spacing)
